newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Tea says not up for sale.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Tea says not up for sale.

text.p: India's Tata Tea Ltd, the world's largest tea company, said on Thursday the firm was not up for sale.

"Tatas have no intention whatsover, to sell their shareholding in Tata Tea Ltd either to Hindustan Lever Ltd or to any other company," chairman Ratan Tata said in a signed public announcement appearing in local newspapars.
He was responding to persistent rumours that Tata Tea was in the process of being sold to Hindustan Lever, which is the Indian subsidiary of Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc .

"It is the firm intention of the Tatas to expand Tata Tea's business and its activities, both in India and abroad and there is, therefore, no question of divesting this company from the Tata Group," the statement said.
